# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Role:** schoolboy  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Anthony Pye is a young boy with a dark, sullen face.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)_

## Personality

Anthony Pye is a mischievous character who possesses a dark, sullen countenance and a hostile demeanor. He exhibits an impertinent swagger and a tendency to smirk and whisper covertly.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)_

## Traits

## History

Anthony Pye was an orphan taken in by his aunt, Mrs. George [Pye](../codex/factions.md#pyes). As a student at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, he initially behaved sullenly toward his teacher, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). After placing a mouse in Anne's desk, he was whipped by her, which earned his respect and approval.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), +7 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--anthony-pye.md)

Anthony Pye is a student in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's classroom. Their relationship shifts dramatically after Anthony puts a mouse in Anne's desk during a tense school day, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to whip him for his misbehavior. Following the punishment, Anthony develops a new respect and approval for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as his teacher.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), +6 more_
